initialState: Each actor starts a fresh browser on the same explicitly blocked primary page. No spontaneous discovery of a dead end is claimed.
pairPolicy: Same initial product, goal, base input and images. Current-candidate actors also use concise self-contained role-question wording to fit the request context; legacy questions are byte-unchanged. Current evidence policy, explicit context questions and this wording are a declared combined intervention. Visual extraction adds a separately tracked input/stage. Rotate actor order per fixture; later trajectories may differ.
retryPolicy: No retries, failed-slot replacement, direct saved-input resends or human data. Stop the next trial on authentication, quota or accounting failure.
